# A derived function keeps what it last answered until a write of what it
# reads, on each target whose reactivity is lowered (internal/lower/memo.go):
# a list a render, a text and another derived function all read is built
# once per write rather than by each. A click's write, a test's write and a
# second write of another var each move what it answers, and so does the
# locale, which passContext hands it as a parameter it compares.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '^ok +2 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '^ok +2 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout '^ok +2 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout '^ok +2 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=c app.sngl
stdout '^ok +2 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=win32 --language=go app.sngl
stdout '^ok +2 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=win32 --language=c app.sngl
stdout '^ok +2 tests, 0 failures$'

-- app.sngl --
import i18n "sngl:i18n"
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component shelf ui.node {
    var items = ["a"]
    var mark = "!"

    func rows() list[string] {
        return items.map(func(s string) => "{s}{mark}")
    }

    func greetings() list[string] {
        return rows().map(func(r string) => "{$"Hello"} {r}")
    }

    ui.vbox {
        for var r = rows() {
            ui.text #row(value=r)
        }
        ui.text #count(value="{rows().length()}")
        ui.text #hello(value=greetings().format())
        ui.button #add(text="add", @click { items.push("b") })
        ui.button #ask(text="mark", @click { mark = "?" })
    }
}

ui.window {
    shelf()
}

func testADerivedListFollowsEachWrite(t test.Test, c shelf) {
    t.assert(c.count.value == "1")
    c.add.click()
    t.assert(c.count.value == "2")
    t.assert(c.row[1].value == "b!")
    c.ask.click()
    t.assert(c.row[0].value == "a?")
    t.assert(c.hello.value == "Hello a?, Hello b?")
    c.items = ["c"]
    t.assert(c.count.value == "1")
    t.assert(c.hello.value == "Hello c?")
}

func testADerivedListFollowsTheLocale(t test.Test, c shelf) {
    t.assert(c.hello.value == "Hello a!")
    t.setContext(i18n.locale, "fr")
    t.assert(c.hello.value == "Bonjour a!")
    c.add.click()
    t.assert(c.hello.value == "Bonjour a!, Bonjour b!")
}
-- i18n.manifest.json --
{
  "Hello": {"translations": {"fr": "Bonjour"}}
}
